summary: Bastion entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Bastion

emulation.notes: Use native PC or platform-holder releases.

primary.why: Bastion is available on current PC storefronts, and Windows offers the cleanest capture/settings path without losing sourced story content. Console and mobile versions are useful for input/platform comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows PC build. Record storefront, build, resolution, controller/keyboard setup, difficulty/idols, New Game Plus state, proving grounds, narrator/audio settings, and whether console/mobile routes were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the capture target, but console routes are official and current enough for controller comparison.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for mobile UI comparison.
secondary.why: Mobile controls differ from the primary archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront/build and difficulty/idols; do not merge New Game Plus with first-clear progress.
